Class MoleculeSync

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.molecule.MoleculeSync
public final class MoleculeSync extends Object

  • Method Details

    • measure

      public static MoleculeSync.Budget measure(MoleculeResources.Data data) throws IOException
      Measures an entire merged collection without publishing it or retaining a compressed copy. Unlike encode, this continues counting after the snapshot limit so authors see the actual total and every exceeded entry limit. Individual strings are still processed one at a time; the result is not an estimate of ZIP file sizes.
      Parameters:
      data - selected raw definitions and dictionaries after overrides and rules
      Returns:
      actual wire sizes and validation problems
      Throws:
      IOException - if compression fails
